comments.author: Xiaomin4114
comments.body: "Vex", "Lyra". AI will keep re-using these names when asked to come up with names. If do it enough times and you'll start seeing Elara, Vance, Vane, Vale, over and over again. I highly recommend coming up with some new names to avoid the obvious "AI named these" tell

replies.author: XXXKscenario
replies.body: lmao bro it's ALWAYS pushing "Vale" (also "Mercer"). Eventually I actually used Vale as a surname for a character; maybe I'M the bot?

replies.author: monsterfurby
replies.body: Not to mention there are excellent name generator APIs and libraries that predate GenAI and can be used for both dictionary-style naming (i.e. name lists by nationality/type like Faker, for example) and naming based on examples and templates (for fantasy names). One of the first things I learned when playing around with random character generation using LLMs was that the LLM should never decide names when there are dedicated tools that roll names just fine.

replies.author: adversecounsel
replies.body: Always code over LMs whenever possible. Should be threshold rule.

comments.author: anaveragebest
comments.body: Looks decent, 1 advice/heads up: Ability names I'd definitely tune yourself. Those are some very obvious AI naming of things. I'm not sure where it pulls that stuff from, but it's terrible at being unique with the ability names.
